item_argument_dependencies.argument: Declare finite oscillator and atom data, their SI conventions, finite Bogoliubov-coordinate interface, ideal number and homodyne outcome models, and separately chosen approximations. This is an adopted finite-mode assignment, not an experimentally identified continuum field model.
Define the dimensionless one-mode equal-time factorial count statistic from ideal number probabilities, for finite second factorial moment and finite positive mean.
From the adopted one-mode, two-level rotating-wave Hamiltonian, prove finite excitation invariance, block matrices and splittings, and self-adjointness of the stated direct-sum extension.
Conditionally implement the specified passive two-mode convention and derive the number-input binomial law and coherent-input product output from occupation-basis amplitudes.
Prove the vacuum-environment one-mode partial-trace map is CPTP on the full trace-class Fock space, with number-state binomial thinning and coherent attenuation; include both endpoint maps.
Use the resonant one-excitation block and adopted autonomous P4 evolution to calculate the excited-state probability and its returns to one.
Evaluate the ideal one-photon factorial statistic and the two-port number-count law after passive mixing with vacuum; make no empirical detector claim.
